LESSON: ATTRIBUTES OF GOD

Grade: Grade 4
Subject: CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
Strand: Creation
Topic 1.6: Attributes of God

SECTION 1: WELCOME

• Today’s class: Attributes of God
• How we learn: Teach → Worked example → Try this
• Use point notes. Show working. Then take the quiz.
• Big question: Why should you know the attributes of God?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

1. read scriptures on the attributes of God
2. recognise God as a loving Father who knows them by their names

SECTION 3: CLASS STUDY (TEACH → EXAMPLE → TRY)

▸ Skill 1: read scriptures on the attributes of God

Teach
• Today’s focus: read scriptures on the attributes of God.
• Listen/read the idea.
• Watch/study the model.
• Then do Try this.

Worked example
• Model A for “read scriptures on the attributes of God” using a school example.
• Model B for “read scriptures on the attributes of God” using a home/county example.

Try this
• Your turn: show "read scriptures on the attributes of God" in 3 bullet points.
• Share with a partner and improve one bullet.

▸ Skill 2: recognise God as a loving Father who knows them by their names

Teach
• Today’s focus: recognise God as a loving Father who knows them by their names.
• Listen/read the idea.
• Watch/study the model.
• Then do Try this.

Worked example
• Model A for “recognise God as a loving Father who knows them by their names” using a school example.
• Model B for “recognise God as a loving Father who knows them by their names” using a home/county example.

Try this
• Your turn: show "recognise God as a loving Father who knows them by their names" in 3 bullet points.
• Share with a partner and improve one bullet.


SECTION: QUICK EXAMPLES

• Model 1: read scriptures on the attributes of God
• Model 2: recognise God as a loving Father who knows them by their names

SECTION: PRACTICE NOW

1. Practise: read scriptures on the attributes of God
2. Practise: recognise God as a loving Father who knows them by their names

SECTION: WORK TO DO

1. Make a one-page revision sheet for Attributes of God.
2. Teach someone at home for 2 minutes using bullet points only.

SECTION: THINK ABOUT IT

1. Why should you know the attributes of God?

SECTION: REMEMBER

• read scriptures on the attributes of God
• recognise God as a loving Father who knows them by their names

• Next: complete the Revision Quiz. Open Answers only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Classroom study notes (Strategy 2)
